items.title: Why younger generations are worse off than baby boomers
items.description: According to research from the Actuaries Institute, inequality between the younger and older generations is widening and could reach record levels within years.

items.title: Live: Auction clearance rates at 2022 housing downturn levels, ASX climbs
items.description: Auction clearance rates have fallen to levels not seen since the 2022 housing downturn. The ASX is up solidly as oil prices drop on hopes of a Middle East peace deal. Follow live.

items.title: Major winemaker threatens to move business overseas if tax changes go through
items.description: The managing director of Taylors Wines in South Australia is threatening to move the business internationally in response to the federal government's proposed tax changes.

items.title: KPMG boss quits amid auditing scandal
items.description: KPMG Australia chief executive Andrew Yates has stepped down amid a scandal involving audit partners accessing confidential client documents.

items.title: Australians have 'startlingly' low awareness of controllable dementia risk factors
items.description: Too many Australians still see dementia as an inevitability, according to new data, but there is a list of steps you can take to reduce the risks.

items.title: Blue Origin rocket explodes on launch pad during test
items.description: Blue Origin says it has experienced an "anomaly", a term commonly used by rocket companies to describe a launch failure or explosion.

items.title: A 'horror night' of airstrikes leaves city wondering what's next
items.description: New waves of missile strikes and vast advisories from the Israeli government to evacuate have left residents in Lebanon's south uncertain of where to turn.

items.title: White House asks Americans to report their neighbours as 'aliens'
items.description: The website features a space-inspired background but its real purpose is to highlight the work of ICE.

items.title: James Valentine remembered as 'wonderful human being' at public memorial
items.description: The veteran broadcaster's family, friends and loyal listeners gathered in Sydney Town Hall to pay tribute to the 64-year-old who died last month, two years after being diagnosed with cancer.

items.title: Trump appointees push for $250 note featuring US president's face
items.description: The decision will be made by the US House and Senate, but reports say Donald Trump's supporters are pushing to expedite the process.

items.title: What the fight over London data centre plans tells us about the AI backlash
items.description: Last year in the US alone, projects collectively worth $200 billion were scuppered or delayed as communities protested the construction of new data centres promised to deliver the AI of the future.

items.title: Erin Patterson's appeal against mushroom murder conviction set for August
items.description: Erin Patterson's appeal against her triple murder conviction will be heard in August, Victoria's Supreme Court has confirmed, with the director of public prosecutions also challenging the length of her jail term.

items.title: Farnham says he will not sing on stage again ahead of tribute concert
items.description: Jimmy Barnes, Tina Arena and Human Nature will take the stage to honour Australian legend John Farnham at a Melbourne tribute concert later this year.

items.title: This comedian has 1.7m followers. He doesn't think it's real
items.description: As a comedian with legions of fans on social media, Will Gibb wishes he didn't still feel the need to legitimise himself. But he does.

items.title: 'Disappointing': Man loses home deposit over feud with developer
items.description: It was lauded as a solution to the housing crisis, but those involved say plans to build an "eco village" in northern New South Wales have gone awry.

items.title: Our critics can't stop listening to these 10 albums from May
items.description: From long-awaited comebacks to First Nations glam rock and genre-defying polymaths, May was stacked with excellent new releases.

items.title: Heatwaves unbearable in UK 'built for a climate that no longer exists'
items.description: As the mercury climbed around the United Kingdom this week and new May maximums were recorded in multiple areas, the once-welcome sunshine is sparking alarm among many people.

items.title: Queensland prisoner loses appeal to freeze eggs
items.description: The Court of Appeal knocked back the woman's attempt to have her eggs frozen while she serves a ten year prison sentence.

items.title: Two taken into custody as police enter protest camp at Olympic stadium site
items.description: Tensions have flared at Victoria Park after police, firefighters and Brisbane City Council officers entered a protest camp ahead of the $3.6 billion Olympic stadium development.

items.title: How tax rules benefit top earners by $700,000 but median earners by $5,700
items.description: Commonwealth Treasury secretary Jenny Wilkinson says the average top income earner benefited from the existing investment tax arrangements to the tune of $700,000 over their lifetime, versus just $5,700 for median income earners.

items.title: Government defends blocking counterterror documents from Bondi royal commission
items.description: The federal government has made a public interest immunity claim over the documents before the Royal Commission into Antisemitism and Social Cohesion, essentially arguing it is not in the public interest for the documents to be released.

items.title: Eels reveal Moses injury outlook ahead of Origin II
items.description: Parramatta do not have any concerns with the handling of Mitchell Moses's fitness in the NSW Blues set-up, as the Eels skipper faces a race against the clock to play before Game II of State of Origin.

items.title: Newly discovered ancient wasp species named after F1 driver Piastri
items.description: Biologists have named the wasp species Gwesped piastrii, honouring Australian Formula 1 driver Oscar Piastri.

items.title: Refugee who tried to flee the Taliban 15 times finally safe to play cricket
items.description: After the Taliban banned women's sport in Afghanistan, most of the women's cricket team ended up relocating to Australia. Now, they're on tour in the Northern Territory — "a happy ending" after a traumatic journey.

items.title: Amazon sued over alleged button battery safety failure in kids backpacks
items.description: The consumer watchdog is suing Amazon alleging it sold children's unicorn backpacks on its online marketplace that failed to comply with mandatory button battery safety warnings.
